spec.expr: sum(container_memory_rss{runid=~"$runid", commit=~"$commit", branch=~"$branch", name=~".+", name!~"perf-k6.*" }) by (name)

spec.title: Imported resource
spec.description: Total count of all resources across all bundles per second (Higher is better)

spec.title: Export progress
spec.description: NDJSON written to the export sink so far by the running $export (k6 lists the bucket/container every 10s). HAPI keeps its files itself, so it has a single point: the final size.

spec.title: Export sink ingest
spec.description: Network bytes received by the export sinks (cAdvisor): RustFS (S3) and Azurite (Microsoft FHIR) — live write rate of the export under test

spec.title: Export throughput
spec.description: NDJSON bytes divided by the time from the $export kick-off to the completed manifest (Higher is better)
